content: FastAPI ships fastapi.security with zero-extra-dependency schemes: APIKeyHeader(name='X-API-Key') yields str via Depends, HTTPBearer yields HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, both auto_error=True -> 401 + WWW-Authenticate challenge. OAuth2PasswordRequestForm would require python-multipart - avoid. Machine-verified: APIKeyHeader dependency returning 401 when missing works on fastapi 0.115.14. Compare secret with stdlib secrets/hmac.compare_digest; store via existing gogo pattern (env var first, then untracked data/*_token.txt, both gitignored - mirrors kline_source.py Tushare token handling).
